what_makes_it_work: A concrete numbered list of easy foods, each with one food picture and a practical tip, answers a daily question parents have, and two separate comment keywords (allergens, recipes) gave 1,703 comments on 226 likes. It is a food post, not a sleep post, and has the most comments in the set coded here.
lumebook_takeaway: A numbered idea list of 10 with a recipe-style freebie behind a comment word is a strong comment engine; one picture per idea keeps the 18-slide length easy to scan.
